segs.en: H. Handling Clarifications

zh.ai: H. 处理澄清事项

segs.en: Every minute of the contest, some team decides that a statement is ambiguous and sends a clarification request. Elisa is the judge on duty at the clarification desk, and her shift lasts exactly $$$2n$$$ minutes. In that time she must take exactly $$$n$$$ requests and answer every one of them.

zh.ai: 比赛期间，每一分钟都会有某支队伍认为题面存在歧义，并发送澄清请求。Elisa 是负责澄清事务的裁判，她的值班时间恰好持续 $$$2n$$$ 分钟。在此期间，她必须恰好处理 $$$n$$$ 个请求，并回答其中的每一个。

segs.en: The jury rates a shift with an operations score. Taking a request the moment it arrives raises that score, because the team stops waiting. Answering lowers it, because a written reply has to be read by the whole jury before it goes out.

zh.ai: 评审团会根据操作得分评价一次值班。请求一到就立即接手会提高得分，因为团队不再需要等待。回复请求则会降低得分，因为书面回复必须先由整个评审团阅读后才能发出。

segs.en: During minute $$$i$$$ Elisa must do exactly one of the following:

zh.ai: 在第 $$$i$$$ 分钟内，Elisa 必须恰好执行以下操作之一：

segs.en: Take the request that arrived this minute. The score rises by $$$a_i$$$, and the request joins her queue, where it waits to be answered on a later minute.

zh.ai: 处理本分钟到达的请求。分数增加 $$$a_i$$$，该请求加入她的队列，等待在之后的某一分钟得到答复。

segs.en: Answer one request that she took earlier and has not answered yet. The score falls by $$$b_i$$$.

zh.ai: 回答她之前提出但尚未得到答复的一个请求。得分会降低 $$$b_i$$$。

segs.en: A request can only be answered after it has been taken. When the $$$2n$$$ minutes are over, Elisa must have taken exactly $$$n$$$ requests and answered all of them. Determine the highest operations score she can finish her shift with.

zh.ai: 只有在接取请求后才能回答该请求。$$$2n$$$ 分钟结束时，Elisa 必须恰好接取 $$$n$$$ 个请求，并将它们全部回答。求她结束值班时能够获得的最高操作分数。

segs.en: The first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$) — the number of requests Elisa must take and answer.

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$) —— Elisa 必须接收并回答的请求数量。

segs.en: The second line contains $$$2n$$$ integers $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2n}$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$) — the score gained by taking the request that arrives on minute $$$i$$$.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$2n$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2n}$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$) —— 表示接受在第 $$$i$$$ 分钟到达的请求所获得的分数。

segs.en: The third line contains $$$2n$$$ integers $$$b_1,b_2,\ldots,b_{2n}$$$ ($$$1 \le b_i \le 10^9$$$) — the score lost by answering a request on minute $$$i$$$.

zh.ai: 第三行包含 $$$2n$$$ 个整数 $$$b_1,b_2,\ldots,b_{2n}$$$($$$1 \le b_i \le 10^9$$$)——表示在第 $$$i$$$ 分钟响应请求所损失的分数。

segs.en: Print one integer — the highest operations score Elisa can finish her shift with, having taken and answered exactly $$$n$$$ requests.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数——Elisa 在接收并回答了恰好 $$$n$$$ 个请求后结束轮班时所能获得的最高运营得分。

segs.en: D. Divided Banner

zh.ai: D. 被分割的横幅

segs.en: The sponsor banner was left outside during the night, and the wind tore it into $$$n$$$ fragments. The banner was cut along its height, so every fragment still has the full height of the original banner, from the bottom edge to the top edge.

zh.ai: 赞助商横幅昨夜被留在室外，风把它撕成了 $$$n$$$ 块。横幅是沿高度方向切开的，因此每块碎片都保留了原横幅的完整高度，从底边一直延伸到顶边。

segs.en: Each fragment is a filled convex polygon. Every fragment is contained between the horizontal lines $$$y=0$$$ and $$$y=H$$$, the bottom and the top edge of the banner, and touches both lines.

zh.ai: 每个碎片都是一个实心凸多边形。每个碎片都位于水平线 $$$y=0$$$ 和 $$$y=H$$$ 之间，这两条线分别是横幅的底边和顶边，并且每个碎片都与这两条线接触。

segs.en: The volunteers want to hang all the fragments again on the wall behind the scoreboard, and that wall is short. They may hang the fragments in any order and move each fragment to the left or to the right by any real distance. They may not move a fragment up or down, rotate it, or turn it over: every fragment hangs from the same rail, with its bottom edge on the line $$$y=0$$$.

zh.ai: 志愿者们想把所有碎片重新挂到记分牌后面的墙上，但这面墙很短。他们可以按任意顺序悬挂碎片，也可以将每块碎片向左或向右移动任意实数距离。他们不能上下移动碎片、旋转碎片或翻转碎片：每块碎片都挂在同一根横杆上，且其底边都位于直线 $$$y=0$$$ 上。

segs.en: An arrangement is valid if the interiors of every two fragments are disjoint. Their boundaries are allowed to touch, and a fragment hung exactly against its neighbour is what the volunteers want.

zh.ai: 如果任意两个碎片的内部都不相交，则称这种排列合法。它们的边界可以接触，而志愿者希望每块碎片都恰好紧挨着相邻碎片悬挂。

segs.en: The length of an arrangement is the difference between the largest and smallest $$$x$$$-coordinates occupied by any fragment, that is, the piece of wall it needs. Find the minimum possible length of a valid arrangement.
The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$H$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 18$$$, $$$1 \le H \le 10^4$$$) — the number of fragments and their common height.

zh.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$H$$$($$$1 \le n \le 18$$$、$$$1 \le H \le 10^4$$$)——碎片的数量及其共同高度。

segs.en: The description of the $$$n$$$ fragments follows.

zh.ai: $$$n$$$ 片段的说明如下。

segs.en: For each fragment, the first line contains an integer $$$k_i$$$ ($$$3 \le k_i \le 300$$$) — the number of vertices of the polygon.

zh.ai: 对于每个片段，第一行包含一个整数 $$$k_i$$$($$$3 \le k_i \le 300$$$)——多边形的顶点数。

segs.en: Each of the next $$$k_i$$$ lines contains two integers $$$x_{i,j}$$$ and $$$y_{i,j}$$$ ($$$-10^4 \le x_{i,j} \le 10^4$$$, $$$0 \le y_{i,j} \le H$$$) — the coordinates of its $$$j$$$-th vertex.

zh.ai: 接下来的 $$$k_i$$$ 行中的每一行包含两个整数 $$$x_{i,j}$$$ 和 $$$y_{i,j}$$$($$$-10^4 \le x_{i,j} \le 10^4$$$、$$$0 \le y_{i,j} \le H$$$)——表示其第 $$$j$$$ 个顶点的坐标。

segs.en: The vertices of every polygon are given in counterclockwise order. It is guaranteed that:

zh.ai: 每个多边形的顶点均按逆时针顺序给出。保证：

segs.en: every polygon is convex (not necessarily strictly convex) and has positive area;

zh.ai: 每个多边形都是凸的（不一定是严格凸的），且面积为正；

segs.en: consecutive vertices on the boundary may be collinear;

zh.ai: 边界上的相邻顶点可能共线；

segs.en: every polygon has at least one point on $$$y=0$$$ and at least one point on $$$y=H$$$;

zh.ai: 每个多边形在 $$$y=0$$$ 上至少有一个点，并且在 $$$y=H$$$ 上至少有一个点；

segs.en: the sum of $$$k_i$$$ over all fragments does not exceed $$$300$$$.

zh.ai: 所有片段中 $$$k_i$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$300$$$。

segs.en: Coordinates belonging to different fragments are expressed in independent local coordinate systems.

zh.ai: 属于不同片段的坐标采用彼此独立的局部坐标系表示。

segs.en: Print one real number — the minimum possible length of a valid arrangement.

zh.ai: 输出一个实数——有效排列的最小可能长度。

segs.en: Your answer is considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $$$10^{-6}$$$.

zh.ai: 如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $$$10^{-6}$$$，则会被判定为正确。

segs.en: In the second example, the two triangular fragments can share a slanted boundary, so their projections on the $$$x$$$-axis may completely overlap.

zh.ai: 在第二个例子中，两个三角形碎片可以共用一条倾斜边界，因此它们在 $$$x$$$ 轴上的投影可能完全重叠。

segs.en: In the third example, the first fragment reaches $$$x=4$$$ halfway up the banner. The rectangular fragment can be placed immediately to its right, touching it at that point, for a total length of $$$5$$$.

zh.ai: 在第三个示例中，第一个片段延伸到横幅中部的 $$$x=4$$$ 处。矩形片段可以紧贴该点放置在它的右侧，总长度为 $$$5$$$。
